description: Use when a bank, insurer, investment firm, payment or crypto-asset firm or other financial entity has an IT outage, cyber attack or data incident and asks whether it must be reported under DORA. Classifies the ICT-related incident as major or not under DORA, applying the criteria and materiality thresholds of Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1772 (Arts. 6, 8 and 9). Returns the decision, which criteria are met, and the reporting time limits if major. Leave out what you do not know.

affected_clients_percent.description: Affected clients as % of all clients using the affected service

affected_counterparts_percent.description: Affected financial counterparts as % of those active in the affected service

affected_transactions_number_percent.description: Affected transactions as % of the daily average number for the service

affected_transactions_value_percent.description: Affected transaction amount as % of the daily average value for the service

affects_authorised_or_supervised_service.description: Financial services requiring authorisation or registration, or supervised, are affected (Art. 6(b))

affects_critical_or_important_functions.description: ICT services or systems supporting critical or important functions are affected (Art. 6(a))

costs_and_losses_eur.description: Direct and indirect costs and losses per Art. 7, without financial recoveries

critical_service_downtime_hours.description: Downtime of ICT services supporting critical or important functions

data_impact_adverse.description: Impact on availability, authenticity, integrity or confidentiality of data that harms business objectives or regulatory compliance (Art. 9(5)(a))

relevant_clients_or_counterparts_affecte.description: Clients or counterparts identified as relevant under Art. 1(3) are affected

reputational_impact.description: Media coverage, repetitive complaints, likely failure to meet regulatory requirements, or likely loss of clients with material impact (Art. 2)

successful_malicious_unauthorised_access.description: A successful, malicious and unauthorised access to network and information systems occurred that may result in data losses (Arts. 6(c), 9(5)(b))

name: dora_classify_incident
title: DORA major ICT-related incident check
